trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then side missions, activities, collectibles, money and crime — and this trophy pops with the last one you need. Nothing about it can be missed; it is the final reward for finishing everything else. PowerPyx and GTABase both rate the platinum 4/10 at about 200 hours, in a single playthrough with no online trophies and no mission replay; the hardest single trophy is A Long Road, the 100% completion gold.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the in-game completion counter must read 100 out of 100. This is a cleanup trophy: it counts story, side missions, activities and collectibles together, so it unlocks naturally once nearly everything else is done. Use the tracker's counter to watch the percentage climb, and check the in-game stats page to see which category is still short. It cannot be missed; it can be finished any time after the story. PowerPyx and GTABase rank this the hardest trophy. The 100% checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. It is closer to 60% true completion: you need 70 of the 80 challenges, all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret quests — but only 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, and 15 of 18 card sets.
